x, y, n = map(float, input().split())

best_num = 0
best_den = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    ratio = x / y
    candidate_floor = int((ratio * i) // 1)  # floor
    candidate_ceil = int((ratio * i + 0.9999999999) // 1)  # ceil approximation

    if abs(ratio - candidate_floor / i) < abs(ratio - best_num / best_den):
        best_num = candidate_floor
        best_den = i
    if abs(ratio - candidate_ceil / i) < abs(ratio - best_num / best_den):
        best_num = candidate_ceil
        best_den = i

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
</translated_code>
